sling_shot.name: Sling Shot
sling_shot.description: Hurl a well-aimed stone to daze the opponent. Deals {dice} ranged physical damage and inflicts a {power} penalty to their rolls ({effect}).

bone_toss.name: Bone Toss
bone_toss.description: Rip a bone from its own body and hurl it with unnatural force. Deals {dice} bludgeoning damage.

blink_strike.name: Blink Strike
blink_strike.description: Blink out of existence and reappear to strike from a blind spot. Deals {dice} physical damage and inflicts a {power} penalty to the target's rolls ({effect}).

swift_strikes.name: Swift Strikes
swift_strikes.description: Unleash a blistering flurry of strikes. Modifies the standard attack count by {attack_count_overide}, with each rapid blow dealing {dice} physical damage.

screech.name: Screech
screech.description: Unleash a maddening, magical screech that resonates across the battlefield. Deals {dice} damage to ALL enemies and leaves them vulnerable, inflicting a {power} penalty ({effect}). A successful save halves the damage.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.description: Conjure a sphere of magical darkness that engulfs the battlefield. ALL enemies are unavoidably rendered {effect} for {duration} turns.

gore.name: Gore
gore.description: Deliver a brutal, tearing thrust with sharp horns. Deals an initial {dice} physical damage and causes severe bleeding for an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Launch into a thundering, unstoppable charge. Deals {dice} bludgeoning damage and leaves the target {effect} for {duration} turns.

petrifying_gaze.name: Petrifying Gaze
petrifying_gaze.description: Lock eyes with a target to turn their flesh to stone. The target must succeed on a save or become {effect} for {duration} turns.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Unleash a wide, sweeping swing that cuts through enemy lines. Deals {dice} physical damage to all targets in the area. A successful save halves the damage.

putrid_claw.name: Putrid Claw
putrid_claw.description: Slash with a rotting, disease-ridden claw. Deals {dice} necrotic damage. On a hit, inflicts the {on_hit_effect} status for {duration} turns.

drain_life.name: Drain Life
drain_life.description: Siphon the vitality from an enemy to heal wounds. Deals {dice} necrotic damage and applies {on_hit_effect}, restoring health equal to the damage dealt.

raise_dead.name: Raise Dead
raise_dead.description: Channel dark magic to animate the fallen. Summons {summon_count} undead servant(s) to fight for the caster.

summon_greater_undead.name: Summon Greater Undead
summon_greater_undead.description: Tear through the veil of death and bind the fallen to your will. Summons {summon_count} Ghoul(s) and Ghast(s) to serve you.

necrosis.name: Necrosis
necrosis.description: Unleash a devastating wave of rotting necrotic energy. Deals an initial {dice} necrotic damage to ALL enemies. Those caught in the blast continue to decay, taking {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

eldritch_smite.name: Eldritch Smite
eldritch_smite.description: Channel forbidden eldritch power into a single, devastating strike. Unavoidably deals {dice} magical damage.

fire_breath.name: Fire Breath
fire_breath.description: Exhale a searing cone of absolute inferno. Deals {dice} fire damage to ALL enemies in the blast zone. A successful save halves the damage.

stinger_strike.name: Stinger Strike
stinger_strike.description: Thrust with a venomous stinger to paralyze and poison the target. Deals an initial {dice} piercing damage, inflicts a {power} penalty to their rolls ({effect}), and poisons them for an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

tail_swipe.name: Tail Swipe
tail_swipe.description: Sweep a massive, crushing tail through the enemy ranks. Deals {dice} bludgeoning damage to all targets in the area. A successful save halves the damage.

dragon_breath.name: Dragon Breath
dragon_breath.description: Unleash the ultimate destructive force of dragonkind. Deals a cataclysmic {dice} elemental damage to ALL enemies on the battlefield. A successful save halves the damage.

lesser_heal.name: Lesser Heal
lesser_heal.description: Channel a brief surge of restorative magic. Consumes current MP to restore {dice} HP.

heal.name: Heal
heal.description: Call upon potent restorative magic. Consumes current MP to restore a solid {dice} HP.

greater_heal.name: Greater Heal
greater_heal.description: Unleash a powerful burst of pure healing energy. Consumes current MP to restore a massive {dice} HP.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.description: Stimulate rapid cellular growth to close gaping wounds. Consumes current MP to instantly restore {dice} HP, and continues to heal for {hot_dice} HP at the start of each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: Command the earth to sprout grasping weeds and crushing vines. All enemies in the area must save or become {effect} for {duration} turns.

needle_burst.name: Needle Burst
needle_burst.description: Violently expel a barrage of razor-sharp needles in every direction. Deals {dice} piercing damage to all enemies in the area.

vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
vicious_mockery.description: Weave subtle enchantments into a string of biting insults. Deals {dice} psychic damage and leaves the target distracted, inflicting a {power} penalty to their rolls ({effect}). A successful save halves the damage.

conjure_minor_elemental.name: Conjure Minor Elemental
conjure_minor_elemental.description: Call upon the spirits of nature for aid. Summons {summon_count} Vine Blight(s) to entangle your enemies.
